persona.label: Busy, wants a callback
persona.description: At work and won't do it by text. Wants a call tomorrow after 5pm. Agent should book a callback, not push.
persona.behavior: You are a nurse on shift and can't text right now. Your first reply is "at work, can't do this now." If offered options, ask for someone to call you tomorrow after 5pm. Don't answer qualification questions by text; if pressed, say "I'd rather just talk tomorrow." Once a callback is confirmed, say thanks and stop replying.

transcript.text: Hi Sam, this is Dana, an automated assistant with Bayview Community Credit Union. Thanks for reaching out about refinancing. Is now a good time for a few quick questions? You can reply STOP at any time to opt out.
at work, can't do this now.

No problem, Sam, thanks for letting me know. I can ask a couple of quick questions by text whenever you have a moment, or I can set up a call with a loan officer at a time that works for you. Which would you prefer?
Can someone call me tomorrow after 5pm?
Your call is booked, Sam. A licensed member loan officer from Bayview will call you at this number tomorrow after 5pm. Have a good rest of your day at work.

events.name: schedule_callback

input.notes: Sam Ortiz submitted a refinance web inquiry. They were at work and couldn't text, so no qualification details were collected. Membership is not confirmed yet. They asked for a call tomorrow after 5pm Pacific, which is outside standard loan team hours (weekdays 9-5 PT). Please confirm membership, goal, home value, balance, rate, credit range, occupancy, and timeline.

events.result: Callback booked. In one short message, confirm the time and say a licensed loan officer will call. Then close.

callback.notes: Sam Ortiz submitted a refinance web inquiry. They were at work and couldn't text, so no qualification details were collected. Membership is not confirmed yet. They asked for a call tomorrow after 5pm Pacific, which is outside standard loan team hours (weekdays 9-5 PT). Please confirm membership, goal, home value, balance, rate, credit range, occupancy, and timeline.

objections.rationale: Follows the playbook closely. Turn 2 is gracious ("No problem, Sam, thanks for letting me know") and offers both options: quick texts or a scheduled call. Turn 4 confirms the callback and ends warmly. It loses a point because turn 4 firmly commits to a time outside standard loan team hours without setting any expectation.

judge.naturalness_rationale: The messages are brief, warm and personalized, and they adapt to the borrower being at work. "Have a good rest of your day at work" reads like a human coordinator. It isn't long or scripted for text.
judge.experience_rationale: Sam got a fast, respectful exit and knows who will call, how and when (turn 4: "A licensed member loan officer from Bayview will call you at this number tomorrow after 5pm"). However, that time is outside the team's 9-5 PT hours, so the firm promise risks a missed call and broken trust.

compliance_issues.excerpt: Your call is booked, Sam. A licensed member loan officer from Bayview will call you at this number tomorrow after 5pm.
compliance_issues.explanation: The agent's own notes say after 5pm is outside standard loan team hours (weekdays 9-5 PT). Stating the call as a certainty overpromises. The agent should have noted that someone would confirm, or offered a time within hours.

annotations.note: Discloses that Dana is "an automated assistant" up front and includes STOP opt-out language.
Responds graciously to the busy objection and offers exactly the two playbook options without pushing questions.
Firmly promises a call "tomorrow after 5pm" even though that is outside loan team hours, with no hedge and no alternative offered.
Confirms who will call ("a licensed member loan officer"), by what channel ("at this number") and when, then closes warmly without pressure.

judge.overall_notes: This is a clean, well-paced busy-objection handling that follows the playbook and respects the borrower's time. The main risk is the unqualified promise of an after-hours callback, which could lead to a missed expectation.
